source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello dear,

I truly apologize for the delay, I had an emergency and had to take a few days off. Thank you for your patience and for sending over multiple takes; I really appreciate your effort.

After reviewing them, I feel that **Take Two** is better than the others especially in terms of pauses, but we'd love to try another version that brings even more energy and liveliness to the delivery.

We actually have an AI-generated sample that I'm sharing now, just as a reference for the tone and energy we’re aiming for. Of course, your vibrant voice will bring it to life far better!

I understand there’s a time difference, but please let me know when you’re available to record today, so I’ll make sure to be online and responsive.

Best regards!

decisions.reason: The request to package the second and third takes separately does not change the requirement to provide alternative recorded takes; the message's assessment is already represented as execution evidence.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that the second and third takes require editing. Separate file delivery is independently represented by the source packaging Requirement.
Selecting the second and third takes for separate edited delivery does not modify the established pacing preferences or final-sentence pacing rule.
The packaging decision does not change the required energy, emotional tone, reference, or restraint of the voice-over performance.

The source message separately changes tone and restraint, and those changes are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY. The pacing change requires no additional update to this Requirement.
Requesting smoother pacing for the preferred first take does not change the existing obligation to provide alternative takes for comparison or establish a new take-count requirement.
The pacing revision does not change the requirement to deliver separate MP3 audio files.
The source also changes final-sentence pacing, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no addition or edit is required.
The requested tonal and pacing adjustments do not change the existing obligation to provide an additional take for comparison.
The performance-direction change does not affect separate-file packaging or the accepted MP3 format.
